claims.text: On 11 March 2026, the European Commission decided to send additional reasoned opinions to Croatia and Germany for incomplete transposition of the EAA. The countries were given two months to respond and take the necessary measures.
claims.stage_detail: Additional reasoned opinions; the generic procedural_stage remains unknown because the schema has no matching Commission-specific value.
